content: Ona ꞌietomotai baleꞌuya
Tuta ꞌana ꞌebe eꞌale ꞌunuya Ona ꞌimiyami. Ta Ona nina tauna Keliso, Yaubada maꞌiyana, ta tauna Yaubada nina.
Tuta nina ꞌana ꞌebe eꞌale ꞌenaya, Ona nina Yaubada maꞌiyana simiyami,
ta Ona nina, tauna Keliso, Yaubada maꞌiyana yage maiboꞌadi simweluluidi, ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate yaita tomweluluwa, ta Ona nina tuga.
Tauna yawasi ꞌaiꞌaila, ta yawasi nina ꞌenega maedana ꞌimeꞌena tomota yauyauda ꞌedaya.
Ta maedana nina guguyoi ꞌenaya ꞌisae, ga guguyoi nigeya ꞌina waiwaimo.
Gote ꞌena Yaubada tai ꞌebweuna ꞌietunenama, ꞌana esana Yoni.
Tauna tomota ꞌediya ꞌimai be ꞌaene tomota ꞌediya maedana manuna ꞌida simana be ꞌenega tomota sida nono be ꞌidi emisa sida saꞌu maedana nina ꞌenaya.
Ta tauna nigeya maedana nina, ta esi maedana ꞌana tosimana.
Ta maedana nina maedana ꞌaiꞌaila ga me baleꞌu maiboꞌada ꞌituyayalida.
Tauna niꞌatu ꞌimai baleꞌuya ga baleꞌuya ꞌimiyami, ta tauna tuga baleꞌu ꞌana tomweluluwa, ta tomiya baleꞌu nigeya simwalamwalatoni yaita tauna.
Ta tuta nina tauna ꞌimai ꞌina buꞌunao ꞌediya taudi wate sieꞌidiꞌidiyena.
Ta esi tomota puꞌepuꞌedimo ꞌina ona siemisena ꞌaene tauna Toꞌetoseyana nina, ga ꞌediya ꞌitagwala be taudi Yaubada natunao.
ꞌEnega tomota getedi tada eesedi ꞌaene taudi niꞌatu situbuwa limana, ta tubuwa limana nina nigeya nadigega tomota laladi nai ꞌidi nuwanuwa ꞌenega, ta esi tubuwa limana nina Yaubada ꞌenega.
Ona nina niꞌatu ꞌedaya ꞌietomotai, ga ꞌina esaesa ꞌena ꞌaꞌitena, tosinabwa sana ꞌituyayalina, manuna tauna Yaubada natuꞌaiꞌailina, ta wate tauna tooboboma ta adelina palupaluna maiboꞌana.

ꞌEnega Yoni ꞌisimanena ga ꞌibwau, ꞌenana sinabwana ꞌenega ꞌigwae, “Tauna gete tai nina manuna yaonaona tuta nina yasimanena ꞌaene ꞌebweu muliguyega ꞌimamai be ꞌida nuganegu, manuna muliyega be yamamai ta tauna niꞌatu ꞌimiyami.”
Tauna toꞌebwaya boboꞌana, ga ꞌina obobomega maiboꞌada ꞌiloemaeda.
Mosese ꞌina ꞌebwaya boboꞌana, nate loina nidi Buki Tabu ꞌena, ta esi Yesu Keliso ꞌina ꞌebwaya boboꞌana wawasae, manuna oboboma be bubuna boboꞌana ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeda.
Nigeya ꞌebweu tuta Yaubada ꞌana ꞌita tomota sida ꞌitena, nate namo natuꞌaiꞌailina selabenaya ꞌimiyami, ꞌenega tauna Tamana ꞌana ꞌita nina niꞌatu ꞌieꞌiteda.
Yoni yaita tauna
Tuta gote ꞌenaya me Yudia ꞌidi toanuganao Yelusalema ꞌenaya simiyami, ga ꞌaidi totaliyao be ꞌaidi Libai ꞌina bodao sietunedi Yoni ꞌenaya sabi enaidena ꞌaene tauna yaita.
Ga Yoni eꞌisa boboꞌana ta maemaedanina ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu nigeya Toꞌetoseyana nina.”

ꞌEnega wate sienaidena ga sigwae, “Ta yaita ꞌoyo? ꞌAene ꞌoyo Ilaitiya, aga?” Ga ꞌiona, “ꞌAboꞌagu nigeya.” Ta wate sienaidena, “Nai ꞌoyo palopita nina Mosese manuna ꞌionaonaya?” Ga Yoni wate ꞌieꞌisa ga ꞌigwae, “Nigeya.”
ꞌEnega taudi wate sigwae, “Ta sana yaita ꞌoyo? Toꞌase ꞌimu ona manuyo, be ꞌenega ꞌada ila be ꞌama toetuneyao ꞌada emataluwedi?”
ꞌEnega Yoni ꞌidi enaida ꞌieꞌisena ga ꞌisimana apwesa, ꞌigwae, “Lowa palopita Aisea ꞌina buki ꞌena manugu ꞌisimana gete nadigega: Tai ꞌebweu sena mitawa daita
ꞌena ꞌibwaubwau, ꞌigwaegwae, ‘ꞌInapwana ꞌina ꞌeda wada kakali ta wagiepaepalu.” ’
Ta Palisiyao ꞌadi toepilialeale nidi
Yoni sienaida limena, sigwae, “ꞌEguma ꞌoyo nigeya Toꞌetoseyana nina, nai ꞌoyo nigeya Ilaitiya, nai ꞌoyo wate nigeya mali palopita, toꞌase manuna ꞌugiegie bapitaiso?”
Ta Yoni ꞌieonedi, “ꞌAboꞌagu bwasiyega tuga tomota yagiegie bapitaisoedi, ta ꞌebweu tai nigeya wamwalamwalatoni gamwagamwanimiya gete tuga ꞌitootoolo,
tauna muliguyega ꞌimeema, ta ꞌaboꞌagu nigeya ꞌilobwelobwenegu be ꞌana ꞌaelawa yada liꞌami, manuna tauna toesaesa sana.”
Gete yage nidi maiboꞌadi siapwesa sena Betani ꞌenaya nate Yoni ꞌina ꞌebe giebapitaiso senanaya, bwasi Yolidani mali esenaya.
Yaubada ꞌina taliya

Ga mali ꞌasiyataya Yoni Yesu ꞌiꞌitena ꞌimeemai ꞌenaya, ga Yoni tomota ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Tai gote tauna Yaubada ꞌina Lami, be me baleꞌu manuda ꞌimwamwawasa be ꞌida bubuna toꞌumalina maiboꞌana ꞌiꞌewayauledi.
Lowa gete tai nina manuna yaonaona, tuta nina yaeonemi ꞌaene tai ꞌebweuna muliguyega ꞌimamai be ꞌida nuganegu, manuna muliyega be yamamai ta tauna niꞌatu ꞌimiyami.
Ta nigeya yamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene yaita tauna, ta nate namo tuga ꞌaboꞌagu me Isileli bwasiyega yagiegie bapitaisoemi be ꞌenega muliyega tauna wada mwalatoni.”
Ona gete Yoni ꞌisimana apwesa Yesu manuna, ga ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Yaluyaluwa Tabuna yaꞌitena ꞌana ꞌita nadigega bunebune galewega ꞌimwaꞌutama ga Yesu ꞌena ꞌitowa.

Lowa nigeya yamwalamwalatoni yaita tauna, ta Yaubada tauna ꞌietuneguma be bapitaiso bwasiyega yada guinuwedi, ga ꞌeguya ꞌisimanena, ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌEtamo Yaluyaluwagu ꞌuda ꞌita ꞌida mwaꞌutama be tai ꞌena ꞌitotowa, tauna nate Yaluyaluwa Tabunega ꞌida giebapitaiso tomota ꞌediya.’ ”
Ta Yoni wate ꞌieonedi, “ꞌAboꞌagu tai nina mata ꞌaiꞌailiguyega yaꞌitena, ꞌenega gete yasimasimana apwesa ꞌaene tauna Yaubada natuꞌaiꞌailina.”
Yesu ꞌana togimi muliyao
Ta mali ꞌasiyataya, tuta nina Yoni be ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌeluwa maꞌenao sitootoolo, ga Yesu siꞌitena selabediyega ꞌitautauya,
ꞌenega Yoni ꞌana tomuliyao nidi ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Tai gote tauna Yaubada ꞌina Lami.”
Gote ꞌena siteluwa nidi Yoni ꞌina ona sinonona, ga Yesu simuliyena.
ꞌEnega Yesu mulinega sitautauya ta ꞌediya ꞌisanaila, ga ꞌiꞌitedi. Ta ꞌienaidedi, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌase nuwanuwami?” Ta taudi sigwae, “Labai, mwaꞌo ꞌimu ꞌebemiya?” (Labai ꞌana gibui Toeꞌita.)
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Wamuliyegu be ꞌenega ꞌigu ꞌebemiya yaeꞌitami.” Ta simuliyena, ga asuinuwanuwaya siapwesa sena nina ꞌenaya, ga nada simiya ebonina.
Tomuliya nidi siteluwa ꞌediyega ꞌebweu ꞌana esana Anidulu, tauna Saimoni Pita tasina.
Anidulu ꞌilomanini ga tasina ꞌilobena ta ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Saimoni, niꞌatu Mesaiya nina ꞌalobena.” (Mesaiya ꞌana gibui Keliso, nate ꞌena Gilisi, ta ꞌana mwalatoi Toꞌetoseyana.)
Ga Saimoni ꞌiꞌauꞌewena ga Yesu ꞌena ꞌimeꞌena. Gote ꞌena Yesu Saimoni ꞌiꞌitena ga ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌOyo ꞌamu esana Saimoni, Yoni natuna, ta ꞌamu esana auwauna yada bwauye Pita, ꞌana gibui Gulewa.”
Ga mali ꞌasiyataya Yesu nuwanuwana be ꞌitatauya Galili, ꞌenega ꞌitauya ga nada Pilipi ꞌilobena, ga ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌUda muliyegu.”
Pilipi ꞌina ꞌasa Beteseida, nate Anidulu be Pita ꞌidi ꞌasa.

ꞌEnega Pilipi Nataniela ꞌilobena, ga ꞌieonena, “Niꞌatu tai nina ꞌalobena, tauna lowa Mosese ꞌina loinao ꞌediya ta wate palopitao ꞌidi ꞌetoladiyao ꞌediya sisimanena, tauna goma Nasaleta, ta Yosepa natuna, ꞌana esana Yesu.”
Ga Nataniela Pilipi ꞌena ꞌigwae, “Nasaleta nigeya ꞌebweu toꞌase boboꞌana ꞌenega ꞌida apwesa.” Ga Pilipi ꞌigwae, “Tuwa tuga, ꞌuda mai be tai nina ꞌuda ꞌita.” ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌena simai.
Ga tuta nina Yesu Nataniela ꞌiꞌitena ga tomota ꞌieonedi Nataniela manuna, ꞌigwae, “Tai gote tauna goma Isileli ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate kabo ꞌenaya.”
Ta Nataniela Yesu ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega ga ꞌenega ꞌumwalatonigu?” Ga Yesu ꞌigwae, “Muliyega be Pilipi ꞌibwauyeyo, ta ꞌaboꞌagu yagimi ꞌitemu damaya ꞌagalaunaya ꞌumiyami.”
Gote ꞌena Nataniela nuwana ꞌiowana ga Yesu ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌoyo onaꞌaiꞌaila Yaubada Natuna, ta ꞌoyo wate me Isileli ꞌima kini.”
Ga Yesu ꞌieonena, “ꞌUemiseguya manuna yaeonemu ꞌaene tuta nina ꞌoyo damaya ꞌagalaunaya yaꞌitemu, aga? Gete tuga ꞌebeꞌita gidalina ꞌemuya, ta maꞌetamo esi yage sinabwadi ꞌuda ꞌitadi.”
Ta Yesu wate ꞌigwae, “Yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya ꞌaene maꞌetamo galewa ꞌegeꞌegegena ꞌena Yaubada ꞌina aniloseyao waꞌitadi, situꞌetuꞌe be simwaꞌumwaꞌutama ꞌaboꞌagu Tomota Natuna manugu.”

footnotes.text: mitawa daita: Me Yudia ꞌidi mitawa kaukau be gulegulewa daisinamo, ta pwatula gidalina, be kaiwenao wate nigeya sinabwadi.
